descriptions.95630: Faced with the prospect of maintaining order in Syndicate in YC128, a region beyond the reach of CONCORD, the Caldari Navy needed a new hard-hitting solution that would establish State authority through its intimidating presence alone. The Naga Navy Issue was commissioned in partnership with the megacorporations of the Mountain faction to ensure that the newly controlled region would witness the uncompromisable honor and strength of the Caldari.
descriptions.95631: The industrial innovations unlocked by Operation Rogue Edge in YC128 allowed the Federation Navy to explore new frontiers of iterative and creative development. The Talos Navy Issue is the result of that design and development program, a sturdier and more damage-efficient version of the basic design.
descriptions.95632:
With the specter of Conquest technology on the horizon in YC128, the Republic Fleet issued a request for a new Balttlecruiser that might help provide some edge to the strike teams expected to be a part of that conflict. Though Conquest technology had been restricted by agreement with CONCORD, many felt that its deployment was inevitable, and the Minmatar wished to be proactive in their fear.
The result was the Tornado Fleet issue, an advanced Republic Fleet vessel. Despite its proud suite of improvements over the original model, detractors claimed that this vessel was merely a conventional weapon that could in no way match the awesome power of the Conquest Engines.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The CPU drawback of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Synchronization Rigging skill.
